# GitHub configuration and project policies

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) | Development workflow, tests and requirements for contributions. |
| [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) | Private vulnerability reporting, credential handling and security checks. |
| [`dependabot.yml`](dependabot.yml) | Weekly update proposals for GitHub Actions dependencies. |
| [`workflows/`](workflows/README.md) | CI, helper builds, privacy and secret scans, dependency auditing and CodeQL analysis. |

GitHub recognizes the contribution and security policies in this directory. The Tesla SDK revision is pinned in [`scripts/build_commands.py`](../scripts/build_commands.py); it is reviewed separately from Dependabot's workflow updates.
